KyoubeAI 1.18.1 lets you close sign-up on a public instance and makes the assistant connection easier to review and publish.

## What's in 1.18.1

**Close sign-up.** Set `KYOUBE_AUTH_DISABLE_SIGN_UP=true` and nobody can create an account, including people accepting an invite. It defaults to `false`, so nothing changes until you set it. To add someone later, set it to `false`, run `docker compose up -d`, let them join, then set it back. On a public instance, `kyoube doctor` now has a `sign-up` line that warns while sign-up is open.

**Better MCP docs.** [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/mcp.md) lists every tool, and the smoke fails if the page and the connection disagree. A new section covers running behind an access gateway such as Cloudflare Access: Claude on the web, Desktop and mobile connects from Anthropic's servers, so `/mcp/kyoubeai`, the two `/.well-known/` paths and `/mcp/oauth/` need a bypass rule. The troubleshooting table shows the core's missing-write-scope message as code, so you can search for it.

**A demo company for reviewers.** `scripts/demo/seed-review-company.mjs` builds a "KyoubeAI Review" company with sample tables, an app, a project with files, an agent and an operator invite, and resets it when run again. A later run keeps an open invite, because its link may already be with a reviewer; pass `--new-invite` to replace it. The script is for directory reviews and is not needed to run KyoubeAI.

## Update

From 1.18, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.18.0. There are no database migrations and nothing to set up. Sign-up stays open until you set `KYOUBE_AUTH_DISABLE_SIGN_UP`, see [docs/operations.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/operations.md), and the full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
